statement_verbatim:
statement: A file under a design root MUST NOT import a relative path that resolves outside the design root. Product capabilities
  and app code import FROM the design system, never the reverse, so the system stays capability-agnostic. Bun realization
  of the outward half of `coder.design.hierarchy-import`, mirroring `coder.vite.design-capabilities-import`.

statement: An app component (`.tsx`/`.jsx` outside the design root) that renders markup MUST import at least one
  design-system element — token, primitive, component, or template — so no UI surface is disconnected from the shared
  system. Bun realization of `coder.design.orphan-ui`.

statement: A file under a design root MUST import only from its own layer or a lower one in the hierarchy tokens/foundations
  (0) <- primitives (1) <- components (2) <- templates (3). Upward edges — tokens importing primitives, primitives
  importing components, components importing templates — are forbidden. Bun realization of the core obligation `coder.design.hierarchy-import`,
  mirroring `coder.vite.design-dependency-flow`.

statement: >-
  A module MUST import only inward: presentation -> application -> domain; integration -> application,
  domain; assembly (the composition root) may reach any layer. Bun realization mirroring
  `coder.convex.design-hierarchy-import`; core obligation `coder.backend.imports-respect-dependency-
  allowed`.

statement: Every component a `primitives`, `components`, or `templates` file exports MUST be imported by at least
  one other file — a higher design layer or app code — so the system stays lean. Re-exports through an `index.*`
  barrel are not consumption. Bun realization of `coder.design.orphan-export`, counting consumers the way `coder.vite.design-orphan-ui`
  does, so composition inside the system (a template using a component) is legitimate.

statement: >-
  A module in the `domain/`, `application/` or `presentation/` layer MUST NOT call the platform `fetch()`
  primitive or a bare `axios` call; outbound HTTP goes through the project's centralized, contract-driven
  client. Bun realization mirroring `coder.vite.boundaries-http-client`; core obligation
  `coder.boundaries.http-client`.

statement: >-
  A product capability document declares a DATA CONTRACT: `produce[]` are the artifacts the product capability owns and
  `consume[]` the ones it takes from other product capabilities (core `capability.schema.json` requires both). The Bun
  implementation MUST name each declared artifact where it moves flow variables, so the declaration and the
  data actually carried cannot drift apart. Core validates that the contract is well formed; only a
  per-stack detector can see whether this stack's code honours it.

statement: >-
  A module under a `commons/application/` or `shared/application/` tree MUST NOT import from the commons
  `integration/` layer. Bun realization mirroring `coder.convex.commons-application-no-integration`; core
  obligation `coder.commons.domain-layer-purity`.

statement: >-
  A module at `commons/<layer>/<feature>/…` MUST NOT import directly into a SIBLING feature's internals;
  cross-feature use goes through the layer root. Bun realization mirroring `coder.convex.commons-cross-
  feature-imports-in`; core obligation `coder.boundaries.no-cross-capability-imports`.

statement: >-
  A module in the `domain/` layer MUST NOT import runtime machinery (`bun:*`, `node:*`, `htmx`, `express`,
  `fastify`, `koa`) nor reach the `Bun.` global. Bun realization mirroring `coder.vite.commons-domain-no-
  framework-import`; core obligation `coder.commons.domain-layer-purity`.

statement: >-
  A module under a `commons/domain/` or `shared/domain/` tree MUST NOT import from the commons
  `application/` or `integration/` layers. Bun realization mirroring `coder.convex.commons-domain-no-
  outbound`; core obligation `coder.commons.domain-layer-purity`.

statement: >-
  Every TypeScript/TSX function MUST keep its cyclomatic complexity at or below 10, so the number of
  independent paths through any one function stays testable. Stack-neutral obligation, NATIVE BUN
  detector: the thresholds and the counting rule are transcribed from the python-pytest sibling
  `coder.refactor.complexity-cyclomatic-typescript` and verified to produce identical numbers, so this
  repo enforces its own metrics without a Python interpreter. Realized by `bun_ts_metrics_detector` (core
  alias COMPLEXITY-CYCLOMATIC-TS-001).

statement: >-
  Every TypeScript/TSX function MUST be at most 50 lines of code, excluding blank and comment lines.
  Stack-neutral obligation, NATIVE BUN detector transcribed from the python-pytest sibling
  `coder.refactor.complexity-length-typescript` and verified numerically identical. Realized by
  `bun_ts_metrics_detector` (core alias COMPLEXITY-LENGTH-TS-001).

statement: >-
  Every TypeScript/TSX function MUST keep its maximum control-flow nesting depth at or below 4. Stack-
  neutral obligation, NATIVE BUN detector transcribed from the python-pytest sibling
  `coder.refactor.complexity-nesting-typescript` and verified numerically identical. Realized by
  `bun_ts_metrics_detector` (core alias COMPLEXITY-NESTING-TS-001).

statement: >-
  A module in the `presentation/` or `application/` layer MUST receive its collaborators by injection
  rather than constructing them. Bun realization mirroring `coder.convex.composition-consumer`; core
  obligation `coder.refactor.composition-consumer`.

statement: >-
  Instantiation of a feature's collaborators (`*Repository`, `*Client`, `*Service`, `*Adapter`,
  `*Gateway`, `*Store`, `*Provider`, `*Factory`) MUST happen only in a composition root —
  `composition.ts`, `capability.ts`, `server.ts`, `index.ts`. Bun realization mirroring
  `coder.convex.composition-root`; core obligation `coder.refactor.composition-root`.

statement: >-
  Every TypeScript/TSX file MUST be reachable, forwards or backwards, from a structural root (`index`,
  `capability`, `composition`, `main`, `app`) through the module import graph. Stack-neutral obligation, NATIVE
  BUN detector; the traversal and root vocabulary are transcribed from the python-pytest sibling
  `coder.dead-code.reachability-typescript`, but the import graph is built by Bun's in-process TypeScript
  parser rather than by regex. Realized by `bun_ts_metrics_detector` (core alias DEAD-CODE-REACHABILITY-
  TS-001).

statement: >-
  A function mapping between a DTO and a domain entity (`to*DTO`, `from*DTO`, `map*DTO*`) MUST live in the
  `integration/` layer. Bun realization mirroring `coder.convex.dto-mapper`; core obligation
  `coder.dto.mapper`.
